statement: For the active phase pair and relative-Y bin, each retained positive-X plane supplies a lower bound on deltaX. For each original source face, either a source edge already holds throughout its full stock-difference rectangle or a retained line dominates a chosen source edge throughout the complete bin. The latter follows exactly from endpoint dominance of two affine functions. Thus every original face has a satisfied rounded outside edge. Retained source planes can be set from truth to extend the compact witness to the original source model. No reverse implication or full-family exclusion from a negative is asserted.
